title: cantnlp@LT-EDI-2023: Homophobia/Transphobia Detection in Social Media Comments using Spatio-Temporally Retrained Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of a classification system for detecting homophobia and transphobia in social media comments for a shared task. It evaluates performance using F1 scores and does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or specific ethical frameworks.
